value.rationale: The restriction to two exactly prescribed-width intervals creates a natural sharp transition in a basic VC set system. The dimension-four onset is linear in width, and the extremal layer has precisely two reflected supports, a structural rigidity phenomenon not implied by the VC dimension of all two-interval unions. This is a motivated classification of the first nontrivial four-query boundary, not a generic reparameterization.
